# ex: implicit & on pattern var cancels with outer * in substitution
# Pattern p is *T, target v is T, so implicitOp='&'.
# In substitution *p, the outer * cancels with the implicit &.
ex {
	import "bytes"
	var p *bytes.Buffer
	p.Len() -> len((*p).Bytes())
}
-- x.go --
package p

import "bytes"

func f(b bytes.Buffer) int {
	return b.Len()
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -3,5 +3,5 @@
 import "bytes"

 func f(b bytes.Buffer) int {
-	return b.Len()
+	return len((b).Bytes())
 }
